key: Read the description of the Pawn?
en: Read the description of the Pawn?
ja: ポーンの説明を読みますか?

key: The Pawn is the basic piece of chess. Eight are stationed in a row on each side.
en: The Pawn is the basic piece of chess.  Eight are stationed in a row on each side.
ja: ポーンは、チェスの基本となる駒である。各陣営に8個、一列に並べられる。

key: The Pawn can only move in one direction: Forward, towards the opposite side of the board, one space at a time.
en: The Pawn can only move in one direction: Forward, towards the opposite side of the board, one space at a time.
ja: ポーンは一方向にしか動けない。盤の反対側に向かって、一度に一マスずつ前進する。

key: The Pawn does not attack the space in front of it, but instead attacks the pieces to the left and right forward diagonal of itself.
en: The Pawn does not attack the space in front of it, but instead attacks the pieces to the left and right forward diagonal of itself.
ja: ポーンは、正面のマスは攻撃せず、代わりに斜め前の左右にある駒を攻撃する。

key: Capturing pieces to its diagonals is the only way in which the Pawn may move sideways.
en: Capturing pieces to its diagonals is the only way in which the Pawn may move sideways.
ja: 斜めの駒を取ることが、ポーンが横に動ける唯一の方法である。

key: Finally, should the daring Pawn reach the far end of the board, it may be promoted into any other non-King piece of the player's choice.
en: Finally, should the daring Pawn reach the far end of the board, it may be promoted into any other non-King piece of the player's choice.
ja: 最後に、勇敢なポーンが盤の反対端に到達した場合、プレイヤーが選ぶ、王以外の任意の駒に昇格することができる。

key: Read the description of the Bishop?
en: Read the description of the Bishop?
ja: ビショップの説明を読みますか?

key: Two Bishops are placed on each side of both players' King and Queen.
en: Two Bishops are placed on each side of both players' King and Queen.
ja: ビショップは、両プレイヤーの王とクイーンの両側にそれぞれ2個ずつ配置される。

key: One is on a white square, the other on a black one.
en: One is on a white square, the other on a black one.
ja: 一方は白マスに、もう一方は黒マスに置かれる。

key: The Bishop can move and attack any number of spaces, but may only move diagonally.
en: The Bishop can move and attack any number of spaces, but may only move diagonally.
ja: ビショップは何マスでも移動・攻撃できるが、斜めにしか動けない。

key: As such, it is limited to whatever color it starts on for the duration of the game.
en: As such, it is limited to whatever color it starts on for the duration of the game.
ja: そのため、ゲームの間ずっと、開始時のマスの色に限定される。

key: Read the description of the Rook?
en: Read the description of the Rook?
ja: ルークの説明を読みますか?

key: One Rook starts at each corner of the board, totalling two on each player's side.
en: One Rook starts at each corner of the board, totalling two on each player's side.
ja: ルークは盤の各隅に1個ずつ置かれ、各プレイヤーにつき合計2個になる。

key: The Rook moves and attacks any number of spaces, but may only move in straight lines.
en: The Rook moves and attacks any number of spaces, but may only move in straight lines.
ja: ルークは何マスでも移動・攻撃できるが、直線にしか動けない。

key: Read the description of the Knight?
en: Read the description of the Knight?
ja: ナイトの説明を読みますか?

key: Two Knights start on each side, in between the Rooks and Bishops.
en: Two Knights start on each side, in between the Rooks and Bishops.
ja: ナイトは各陣営に2個ずつ、ルークとビショップの間に配置される。

key: The Knight is a unique piece in two ways:
en: The Knight is a unique piece in two ways:
ja: ナイトは、二つの点で特殊な駒である:

key: Firstly, its pattern of movement and attack takes the shape of an L. It moves two spaces in one direction, and then one additional space to the side.
en: Firstly, its pattern of movement and attack takes the shape of an L. It moves two spaces in one direction, and then one additional space to the side.
ja: 第一に、その動きと攻撃のパターンはL字を描く。一方向に2マス動き、さらに横に1マス動く。

key: Secondly, it possesses the unique ability to 'jump' over pieces.
en: Secondly, it possesses the unique ability to 'jump' over pieces.
ja: 第二に、駒を「飛び越える」独自の能力を持つ。

key: Unlike other pieces, the Knight is not hindered by opposing pieces, ally or enemy, blocking its path.
en: Unlike other pieces, the Knight is not hindered by opposing pieces, ally or enemy, blocking its path.
ja: 他の駒と違い、ナイトは味方であれ敵であれ、進路を塞ぐ駒に妨げられない。

key: Despite their strange movement pattern, they are not restricted in the squares they may reach as the Bishop is.
en: Despite their strange movement pattern, they are not restricted in the squares they may reach as the Bishop is.
ja: その奇妙な動きのパターンにもかかわらず、ビショップのようにたどり着けるマスが制限されることはない。

key: It is possible for any Knight, starting from any position, to reach any square on the board (given enough turns).
en: It is possible for any Knight, starting from any position, to reach any square on the board (given enough turns).
ja: ナイトは、どの位置から始めても(十分な手数さえあれば)盤上のどのマスにも到達できる。

key: Read the description of the Queen?
en: Read the description of the Queen?
ja: クイーンの説明を読みますか?

key: Each side has one Queen, which starts to the player's left of their King.
en: Each side has one Queen, which starts to the player's left of their King.
ja: 各陣営にクイーンは1個で、プレイヤーの王の左側に配置される。

key: The Queen is regarded as the most valuable attacking piece, as it can move and attack any number of spaces in any direction.
en: The Queen is regarded as the most valuable attacking piece, as it can move and attack any number of spaces in any direction.
ja: クイーンは、どの方向にも何マスでも移動・攻撃できるため、最も価値の高い攻撃駒とみなされている。

key: Read the description of the King?
en: Read the description of the King?
ja: キングの説明を読みますか?

key: The King is the centerpiece of the game.
en: The King is the centerpiece of the game.
ja: 王は、ゲームの中心となる駒である。

key: Each player has exactly one, stationed to the player's right of the Queen.
en: Each player has exactly one, stationed to the player's right of the Queen.
ja: 各プレイヤーはちょうど1個持ち、クイーンの右側に配置される。

key: The King is a weak piece for two reasons:
en: The King is a weak piece for two reasons:
ja: 王が弱い駒である理由は、二つある:

key: The first is that it moves and attacks only one space in any direction.
en: The first is that it moves and attacks only one space in any direction.
ja: 第一に、どの方向にも1マスしか移動・攻撃できない。

key: The second reason is that the King may not move into any position under attack by an opposing piece, otherwise it would place itself in check.
en: The second reason is that the King may not move into any position under attack by an opposing piece, otherwise it would place itself in check.
ja: 第二に、敵の駒に攻撃されている位置には移動できない。さもないと、自らチェックの状態に陥ってしまう。

key: As the object of each game is to checkmate the opposing player's King, this piece should always be protected.
en: As the object of each game is to checkmate the opposing player's King, this piece should always be protected.
ja: ゲームの目的は相手の王をチェックメイトにすることなので、この駒は常に守られるべきである。

key: ELIAS: If you have any questions, I will be happy to address them to my fullest ability.
en: ELIAS: If you have any questions, I will be happy to address them to my fullest ability.
ja: イライアス: ご質問がございましたら、力の及ぶ限りお答えいたします。

key: Chess is a two-player game.
en: Chess is a two-player game.
ja: チェスは、二人で行うゲームです。

key: One side plays 'White' and the other plays 'Black'.
en: One side plays 'White' and the other plays 'Black'.
ja: 一方が「白」、もう一方が「黒」を担当します。

key: White always takes the first move.
en: White always takes the first move.
ja: 白が常に先手を取ります。

key: The objective of the game is to place the enemy's King in checkmate.
en: The objective of the game is to place the enemy's King in checkmate.
ja: ゲームの目的は、敵の王をチェックメイトにすることです。

key: This is done as each player takes turns moving one piece at a time across the board.
en: This is done as each player takes turns moving one piece at a time across the board.
ja: 各プレイヤーが交互に、盤上で一度に一つの駒を動かすことで進行します。

key: There are six kinds of pieces in chess: The King, Queen, Knight, Rook, Bishop and Pawn.
en: There are six kinds of pieces in chess: The King, Queen, Knight, Rook, Bishop and Pawn.
ja: チェスには六種類の駒があります:キング、クイーン、ナイト、ルーク、ビショップ、ポーンです。

key: Please check the statues in this room for descriptions of each piece's function.
en: Please check the statues in this room for descriptions of each piece's function.
ja: それぞれの駒の機能については、この部屋の像をご確認ください。

key: Pieces each move and attack different spaces based on their type.
en: Pieces each move and attack different spaces based on their type.
ja: 駒はそれぞれ、種類に応じて異なるマスを移動・攻撃します。

key: With the exception of the Knight, pieces cannot move through other pieces, allied or otherwise.
en: With the exception of the Knight, pieces cannot move through other pieces, allied or otherwise.
ja: ナイトを除き、駒は他の駒(味方であれ敵であれ)を通り抜けて動くことはできません。

key: The game operates around the concepts of check and checkmate.
en: The game operates around the concepts of check and checkmate.
ja: このゲームは、チェックとチェックメイトの概念を中心に進みます。

key: "Check" refers to a position in which one player's King is under attack by an opposing piece.
en: "Check" refers to a position in which one player's King is under attack by an opposing piece.
ja: 「チェック」とは、あるプレイヤーの王が、敵の駒に攻撃されている状態を指します。

key: This means that, on the opposing player's next turn, the King can be captured.
en: This means that, on the opposing player's next turn, the King can be captured.
ja: つまり、相手の次の手番で、王が取られてしまう可能性があるということです。

key: When a player is in check, their next move MUST remove them from check. No other moves may be taken.
en: When a player is in check, their next move MUST remove them from check. No other moves may be taken.
ja: チェックをかけられているプレイヤーは、次の手で必ずチェックを解消しなければなりません。他の手を打つことはできません。

key: Similarly, a player may not make a move that would place them in check.
en: Similarly, a player may not make a move that would place them in check.
ja: 同様に、プレイヤーは自らチェックの状態になるような手を打つことはできません。

key: Such a move might include moving the King into the path of an opposing piece's attack.
en: Such a move might include moving the King into the path of an opposing piece's attack.
ja: そのような手には、王を敵の駒の攻撃範囲に動かすことも含まれます。

key: However, it may also include moving away a piece that was blocking an opposing piece from reaching one's King.
en: However, it may also include moving away a piece that was blocking an opposing piece from reaching one's King.
ja: また、敵の駒が王に到達するのを防いでいた駒を動かしてしまうことも含まれます。

key: In this case, that blocking piece is pinned in place.
en: In this case, that blocking piece is pinned in place.
ja: この場合、その防いでいた駒は、その場に「ピン留め」された状態になります。

key: In order to get out of check, the King may be moved, a piece may be moved to block the attack on the King, or the attacking piece may be captured.
en: In order to get out of check, the King may be moved, a piece may be moved to block the attack on the King, or the attacking piece may be captured.
ja: チェックから逃れるには、王を動かす、王への攻撃を遮る駒を動かす、あるいは攻撃している駒を取る、のいずれかを行います。

key: 'Checkmate' is a condition of the game in which no move may be taken by a player in check to remove them from that condition.
en: 'Checkmate' is a condition of the game in which no move may be taken by a player in check to remove them from that condition.
ja: 「チェックメイト」とは、チェックをかけられたプレイヤーが、その状態から逃れるための手をまったく打てない状況を指します。

key: In short, it means that there is nothing that player can do to escape having their King captured.
en: In short, it means that there is nothing that player can do to escape having their King captured.
ja: つまり、そのプレイヤーには、王が取られるのを防ぐ手段が何もないということです。

key: The game is then over.
en: The game is then over.
ja: そこでゲームは終了する。

key: This Chess puzzle varies in several key ways from a normal chess game.
en: This Chess puzzle varies in several key ways from a normal chess game.
ja: このチェスパズルは、通常のチェスといくつかの重要な点で異なります。

key: Most notably, Lord Radomus will not be making any moves.
en: Most notably, Lord Radomus will not be making any moves.
ja: 最も重要なのは、ラドマス様が一切手を打たないという点です。

key: As such, you have infinite time to arrange your pieces.
en: As such, you have infinite time to arrange your pieces.
ja: そのため、駒を配置する時間は無制限です。

key: In return, however, Radomus' pieces may not be captured.
en: In return, however, Radomus' pieces may not be captured.
ja: ただし、その代わりに、ラドマス様の駒を取ることはできません。

key: Finally, though they may not be captured or moved, Radomus' pieces will still be considered to be attacking the same space as they normally would.
en: Finally, though they may not be captured or moved, Radomus' pieces will still be considered to be attacking the same space as they normally would.
ja: 最後に、取ることも動かすこともできませんが、ラドマス様の駒は、通常通りの攻撃範囲を持つものとみなされます。

key: Remember this when you attempt to checkmate him.
en: Remember this when you attempt to checkmate him.
ja: チェックメイトを狙う際は、このことを覚えておいてください。

key: ELIAS: About me? There is little to say of a lowly butler.
en: ELIAS: About me? There is little to say of a lowly butler.
ja: イライアス: 私についてですか? 卑しい執事について、語ることはほとんどございません。

key: I serve my Lord with my whole being, for it is Master Radomus who has given my life meaning.
en: I serve my Lord with my whole being, for it is Master Radomus who has given my life meaning.
ja: 私は全身全霊をもって主にお仕えしております。私の人生に意味を与えてくださったのは、ラドマス様なのですから。

key: Behold, my eyes.
en: Behold, my eyes.
ja: ご覧ください、この目を。

key: They are greyed with defect.
en: They are greyed with defect.
ja: 欠陥により、灰色に濁っております。

key: For much of my life, I have been a blind man.
en: For much of my life, I have been a blind man.
ja: 人生の大半、私は盲目でした。

key: But then did I undertake a plea to Lord Radomus.
en: But then did I undertake a plea to Lord Radomus.
ja: しかし、ラドマス様に嘆願を申し上げたのです。

key: In his greatness, he did restore to me my sight.
en: In his greatness, he did restore to me my sight.
ja: その偉大さにより、私に視力を取り戻してくださいました。

key: That is all there is to say about someone like me.
en: That is all there is to say about someone like me.
ja: 私のような者について語れることは、それだけです。
